items.h: Rhode Island Today and Tonight: Gatsby, Jazz and Storytime
items.sum: Tonight's best picks: The Great Gatsby at 7:00 PM at PPAC in Providence and RI Jazz Collective at 6:00 PM at Narragansett Café in Jamestown.

items.h: The Great Gatsby Musical Roars Into PPAC, Nov. 3–8
items.sum: The Tony-winning Broadway musical brings the Roaring Twenties to downtown Providence for eight performances.

items.h: Ballet RI's In Motion Comes to Westerly's United Theatre, Nov. 6
items.sum: Friday, November 6 at 7:30 p.m. at the United Theatre in Westerly, with three works including a company premiere.

items.h: Chorus of Westerly Rings In the Season With Vaughan Williams' Hodie
items.sum: Saturday, November 14 at 6 p.m. and Sunday, November 15 at 3 p.m. at George Kent Performance Hall in Westerly.

items.h: Rhode Island Comic Con takes over Providence, Nov. 6–8
items.sum: Three days of pop culture at the Rhode Island Convention Center and Amica Mutual Pavilion.

items.h: Rhode Island documentary “The Pizza Principal” announces its premiere
items.sum: Filmmaker Kirk Benttinen’s November 20 Providence screening will introduce the film alongside shorts through his RI Docs project.

items.h: Newport County holiday-assistance registration is open
items.sum: The MLK Community Center is accepting in-person applications for holiday food and children’s gifts; Thanksgiving registration ends November 13.

items.h: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Rhode Island marks 60 years
items.sum: Its anniversary breakfast in Lincoln raised more than $100,000 for mentoring programs.

items.h: Newport Classical's holiday concerts bring choral music to December
items.sum: Christmas with Cantus, Messiah at the Mansion and Frisson play Dec. 5, 6 and 12.

items.h: Poe's Providence love story gets a walking tour
items.sum: A walk from the John Reynolds House on Benefit Street focuses on the romantic side of Edgar Allan Poe's time in Providence.
